description: This file defines functions and variables related to configuring TLS cipher suites and versions, including handling insecure ciphers, preferred ciphers, and TLS version options for Kubernetes.

methods.name: InsecureTLSCiphers
methods.description: Returns a map of insecure cipher suite names to their IDs.

methods.name: InsecureTLSCipherNames
methods.description: Returns a list of insecure cipher suite names.

methods.name: PreferredTLSCipherNames
methods.description: Returns a list of preferred cipher suite names.

methods.name: TLSCipherPossibleValues
methods.description: Returns all acceptable cipher suite names, combining insecure and preferred.

methods.name: TLSCipherSuites
methods.description: Converts a list of cipher suite names to their corresponding IDs.

methods.name: TLSPossibleVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of all acceptable TLS version names.

methods.name: TLSVersion
methods.description: Returns the TLS version ID for a given version name.
